description: A rainbow-colored pop-it toy sits on a blue bedspread in front of a large pink pillow. The right hand brings the pop-it in and, together with the left hand, holds it as a two-hand object near the bottom of the frame; both thumbs press and “pop” the silicone bubbles in short, repeated pushes, moving from the lower rows toward the upper red row while the hands adjust their grip slightly but keep the toy centered.
